# Bali Monster Spearfishing

> Spearfishing, freediving, and boat charters in Bali, Indonesia. Dogtooth tuna is the hunt we are known for. Trips are planned one conversation at a time on WhatsApp, and every booking is confirmed with a person before it is made.

Bali Monster Spearfishing is a small operator based in Bali. There is no online booking form and no automated messages. To plan a trip, message +62 822-3695-4017 on WhatsApp (https://wa.me/6282236954017) with the activity, dates, group size, and experience level. Pricing, inclusions, equipment, transport, and meeting points are confirmed in that conversation. Conditions and encounters vary, and catches are never guaranteed.

## Two sides of the site

- [Bali Monster Spearfishing](https://balimonster.com/spearfishing): The hunting side. Spearfishing and freediving trips, with dogtooth tuna as the signature target.
- [Bali Monster Charters](https://balimonster.com/): The homepage and the boat-day side. Snorkeling, sunset cruises, island camping, sportfishing, and island transfers for groups, couples, and families.

## Trips

- [Spearfishing in Bali](https://balimonster.com/spearfishing-bali): Guided spearfishing trips with dogtooth tuna as the target. Planned around the diver's experience and the conditions on the day.
- [Freediving in Bali](https://balimonster.com/freediving-bali): Time in the blue on one breath, without a speargun, planned around comfort in open water.
- [Boat charters in Bali](https://balimonster.com/boat-charter-bali): A day offshore for a group, for spearfishing, freediving, or simply time on the water.

## Information

- [Questions and answers](https://balimonster.com/faq): Booking, experience, pricing, locations, legality, and what to expect.
- [Photos and films](https://balimonster.com/gallery): Real photos and video from past trips. No stock imagery.
- [Homepage](https://balimonster.com/): The charters side: snorkeling, sunset cruises, island camping, sportfishing, island transfers, and how booking works.
